name: gharoo-care
description: Gharoo Care - Full Stack Repair Service Application

scripts.dev:server: node init && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.start:clients: node init && npm run build && npm run dev:clients
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:server && npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && npm run build:service-man
scripts.build:user: node init && npm ci --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client
scripts.build:admin: node init && npm ci --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:service-man: node init && npm ci --prefix service-man-client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix service-man-client
scripts.dev:user: node init && npm run dev --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client
scripts.dev:admin: node init && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev:service: node init && npm run dev --prefix service-man-client
scripts.dev:all: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.start: node init && cd server && node index.js
